# Form 1040 U.S. Individual Income Tax Return 2024

**OMB No. 1545-0074** | IRS Use Only—Do not write or staple in this space.

For the year Jan. 1–Dec. 31, 2024, or other tax year beginning **1/01**, 2024, ending **12/31**, 2024

---

## Personal Information

| | |
|---|---|
| Your first name and middle initial | Last name |
| Rex B | O'Connor |
| Your social security number | |
| 506 03 8020 | |
| If joint return, spouse's first name and middle initial | Last name |
| | O'Connor |
| Spouse's social security number | |

**Home address (number and street). If you have a P.O. box, see instructions.**
7568 Buford Parks
Apt. no. 738

**City, town, or post office. If you have a foreign address, also complete spaces below.**
Findlay

| State | ZIP code |
|---|---|
| WY | 82446 |

Foreign country name | Foreign province/state/county | Foreign postal code

---

## Presidential Election Campaign

*(See instructions)*

---

## Filing Status

Check only one box.

- [ ] Single
- [ ] Married filing jointly (even if only one had income)
- [ ] Married filing separately (MFS)
- [x] **Head of household (HOH)**
- [ ] Qualifying surviving spouse (QSS)

If you checked the MFS box, enter the name of your spouse. If you checked the HOH or QSS box, enter the child's name if the qualifying person is a child but not your dependent:

[ ] If treating a nonresident alien or dual-status alien spouse as a U.S. resident for the entire tax year, check the box and enter their name (see instructions and attach required):

---

## Digital Assets

At any time during 2024, did you: (a) receive (as a reward, award, or payment for property or services); or (b) sell, exchange, or otherwise dispose of a digital asset (or a financial interest in a digital asset)? (See instructions.)

**Yes [x]** | **No [ ]**

---

## Standard Deduction

**Someone can claim:**
- [ ] You as a dependent
- [ ] Spouse itemizes on a separate return or you were a dual-status alien

---

## Age/Blindness

**You:** [x] Were born before January 2, 1960 | [ ] Are blind | **Spouse:** [ ] Was born before January 2, 1960 | [ ] Is blind

---

## Dependents

**(1) First name** | **Last name** | **(2) Social Security number** | **(3) Relationship to you** | **(4) Child tax credit** | **Credit for other dependents**

| First name | Last name | SSN | Relationship | Child tax credit | Other |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Katarina | O'Connor | 495 68 6179 | parent | [x] | |
| Gabe | O'Connor | 440 13 0331 | parent | [x] | |
| Noble | O'Connor | 143 76 5810 | parent | [x] | |

---

## Income

**Attach Form(s) W-2 here. Also attach Forms W-2G and 1099-R if tax was withheld.**

**If you did not get a form W-2, see instructions.**

| Line | Description | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| 1a | Total amount from Form(s) W-2, box 1 (see instructions) | 86630 |
| 1b | Household employee wages not reported on Form(s) W-2 | 8078 |
| 1c | Tip income not reported on line 1a (see instructions) | 1363 |
| 1d | Medicaid waiver payments not reported on Form(s) W-2 (see instructions) | |
| 1e | Taxable dependent care benefits from Form 2441, line 26 | 4907 |
| 1f | Employer-provided adoption benefits from Form 8839, line 29 | |
| 1g | Wages from Form 8919, line 6 | 6822 |
| 1h | Other earned income (see instructions) | |
| 1i | Nontaxable combat pay election (see instructions) | 1232 | 1i | 11 |
| **z** | **Add lines 1a through 1i** | **109032** |
| 2a | Tax-exempt interest | 1403 | **2b** | Taxable interest |
| 3a | Qualified dividends | | **3b** | Ordinary dividends |
| 4a | IRA distributions | 3497 | **4b** | Taxable amount | 6312 |
| 5a | Pensions and annuities | | **5b** | Taxable amount |
| 5b | | | **5b** | Taxable amount |
| 6a | Social security benefits | | **6b** | Taxable amount |
| 7 | Capital gain or (loss). Attach Schedule D if required. If not required, check here | 8241 |
| 8 | Additional income from Schedule 1, line 10 | |
| 9 | Add lines 1z, 2b, 3b, 4b, 5b, 6b, 7, and 8. This is your **total income** | 123585 |
| 10 | Adjustments to income from Schedule 1, line 26 | 4146 |
| 11 | Subtract line 10 from line 9. This is your **adjusted gross income** | 119439 |
| 12 | **Standard deduction or itemized deductions** (from Schedule A) | 6613 |
| 13 | Qualified business income deduction from Form 8995 or Form 8995-A | 8049 |
| 14 | Add lines 12 and 13 | 14662 |
| 15 | Subtract line 14 from line 11. If zero or less, enter -0-. This is your **taxable income** | 104777 |

---

## Standard Deduction

- Single or Married filing separately: **$14,600**
- Married filing jointly or Qualifying surviving spouse: **$29,200**
- Head of household: **$21,900**
- If you checked any box under Age/Blindness, see instructions.

*Attach Sch. B if required.*

---

*Form **1040** (2024)* | Cat. No. 11320B
